title: On Stealing the silver from the front room
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：steal　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 steal 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the trader ① stole the silver from the front room on the same day, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② steals the silver from the front room before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ steal the silver from the front room at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ stolen the silver from the front room before — a line in the list for October 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Stealing the silver from the front room on the same day, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ steal away before anyone was up before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Steal away before anyone was up at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ steals away before anyone was up on the same day every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ stole the silver from the front room again when nobody else would.

⑩ To steal the silver from the front room, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody steals the silver from the front room before dawn again and somebody must steal the silver from the front room on the same day all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 偷（一般过去式 stole the silver from the front room：1965 年货商头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 偷（一般现在 steals the silver from the front room：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 偷（不定式 to steal the silver from the front room：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 偷（过去完成时 had stolen the silver from the front room：1959 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 偷（动名词 stealing the silver from the front room 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 偷偷地走（steal away before anyone was up：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去偷偷地走趁没人起身悄悄走掉）
G. v. 偷偷地走（steal away before anyone was up：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 偷（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 steals away before anyone was up，而母亲又一次 stole the silver from the front room）

answers.why: steal 意为“偷”，1965 年货商当天就偷从前厅偷走了那些银器，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 stole。
steal 意为“偷”，自那以后货商天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 steals。
steal 意为“偷”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯偷从前厅偷走了那些银器”，此处为不定式 to steal the silver from the front room。
steal 意为“偷”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人偷过，故用过去完成时 had stolen。
steal 意为“偷”，货商说“偷从前厅偷走了那些银器这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 stealing the silver from the front room 作主语。
steal 意为“偷偷地走”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去偷偷地走趁没人起身悄悄走掉”，should ever 之后用原形 steal away before anyone was up。
steal 意为“偷偷地走”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻偷偷地走趁没人起身悄悄走掉（steal away before anyone was up at once），以后再也不要提起。
steal 意为“偷”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例偷偷地走趁没人起身悄悄走掉，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 steals。
steal 意为“偷”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就偷从前厅偷走了那些银器，用一般过去式 stole 叙述。
steal 意为“偷”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要偷从前厅偷走了那些银器，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 steal 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the trader stole the silver from the front room on the same day, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader steals the silver from the front room before dawn whenever the market asks.
Stealing the silver from the front room on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever steal away before anyone was up before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market steals away before anyone was up on the same day every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother stole the silver from the front room again, and the market remembered that half.
